instruction: The Stage-1, Stage-2, and Phase-E records are immutable. Inspect the paired case only now. Classify provenance for every Phase-E missing client fact, distinguish sibling necessity from corroboration, apply the fixed verdict precedence, and record narrow bilingual/clinical/scope collateral observations. Do not revise Phase E and do not propose content edits beyond an advisory P0-P3 priority.

content.en: Marcus Delaney is a 38-year-old man with opioid use disorder (OUD) in recovery for about 5 months. He takes buprenorphine/naloxone 16 mg/4 mg sublingual daily through an outpatient medication-assisted treatment (MAT) program and attends weekly group counseling. He has two prior relapses; the most recent was 8 months ago and involved IV heroin use with a nonfatal overdose reversed by paramedics with naloxone. His recovery supports include a Narcotics Anonymous sponsor, his girlfriend Tanya, and his mother. Tanya has been trained to administer naloxone and keeps a kit at home.
content.zh: Marcus Delaney，38 岁，患有阿片类物质使用障碍（OUD），已恢复约 5 个月。他通过门诊药物辅助治疗（MAT）项目每日舌下使用丁丙诺啡/纳洛酮 16 mg/4 mg，并每周参加团体咨询。既往有 2 次复发，最近一次在 8 个月前，涉及静脉使用海洛因，并发生非致死性过量，急救人员用纳洛酮逆转。其恢复支持包括戒毒互助会赞助人、女友 Tanya 和母亲。Tanya 接受过纳洛酮给药培训，家中备有纳洛酮。

content.en: Marcus fell from a loading dock at work and sustained a closed, displaced fracture of the left distal radius. Orthopedics plans closed reduction with procedural sedation in the ED, casting, and outpatient follow-up. Current orders include ketorolac 15 mg IV once, ondansetron 4 mg IV PRN nausea, acetaminophen 1,000 mg PO every 6 hours scheduled, and consultation for a nerve block. The ED provider wrote: “hold buprenorphine/naloxone — will discuss pain plan with patient and MAT prescriber.” No full opioid agonist analgesics have been ordered. Marcus says, “I need you to know I’m in recovery. I don’t want anything that’s going to mess that up. But this pain is really bad.” Pain is 8/10. He is tearful and anxious.
content.zh: Marcus 在工作时从装卸台跌落，造成左桡骨远端闭合性移位骨折。骨科计划在急诊进行程序镇静下闭合复位、石膏固定，并安排门诊随访。目前医嘱包括酮咯酸 15 mg IV 一次、昂丹司琼 4 mg IV 按需用于恶心、对乙酰氨基酚 1,000 mg PO 每 6 小时定时给药，以及神经阻滞会诊。急诊医生写道：“暂缓丁丙诺啡/纳洛酮——将与患者和 MAT 处方医生讨论疼痛方案。”未开具完全阿片受体激动剂镇痛药。Marcus 说：“我需要告诉你，我正在恢复中。我不想用任何会破坏恢复的东西。但这个疼痛真的很严重。”疼痛 8/10。他流泪并焦虑。

content.en: Vital signs: T 98.2 °F (36.8 °C), HR 102, BP 148/92, RR 18, SpO2 99% on room air. Left distal forearm is deformed with moderate swelling. Radial pulse is 2+ and symmetric; fingers are warm with capillary refill under 2 seconds; sensation is intact to light touch; he can flex and extend fingers with pain. No open wound. Pupils equal and reactive, 4 mm. Skin warm and dry. No diaphoresis, tremor, piloerection, rhinorrhea, yawning, vomiting, or GI distress. He reports taking buprenorphine/naloxone this morning. CBC, BMP, hepatic panel, and coagulation results are within expected limits. Urine drug screen is positive for buprenorphine and negative for opiates, benzodiazepines, amphetamines, cocaine, cannabinoids, and methadone. Alcohol level is 0 mg/dL.
content.zh: 生命体征：T 98.2 °F (36.8 °C)，HR 102，BP 148/92，RR 18，室内空气 SpO2 99%。左前臂远端畸形并中度肿胀。桡动脉搏动 2+ 且双侧对称；手指温暖，毛细血管再充盈少于 2 秒；轻触觉完整；可在疼痛下屈伸手指。无开放性伤口。瞳孔等大且对光反应存在，4 mm。皮肤温暖干燥。无出汗、震颤、鸡皮样皮肤、流涕、打哈欠、呕吐或胃肠不适。他报告今晨已服用丁丙诺啡/纳洛酮。CBC、BMP、肝功能和凝血结果在预期范围内。尿药筛查丁丙诺啡阳性，阿片类、苯二氮卓类、苯丙胺、可卡因、大麻素和美沙酮均阴性。血醇浓度 0 mg/dL。

glossary.defZh: 恢复中的患者再次使用物质的可能性，常受压力、疼痛、孤立和可及性影响。
帮助患者维持戒断和应对压力的人或项目，如赞助人、家人、互助会或 MAT 项目。
检测近期药物或物质暴露的尿液检查，不能替代临床风险评估。

segments.en: Marcus says, “Sometimes I think it would be easier if I just didn’t have to deal with any of this anymore.”
segments.zh: Marcus 说：“有时候我觉得如果不用再面对这些，会不会更容易。”

segments.en: He clarifies, “I’m not going to hurt myself.”
segments.zh: 他澄清：“我不会伤害自己。”

segments.en: He says recovery is exhausting and he feels “one bad day away from using again.”
segments.zh: 他说恢复很累，并觉得自己“离再次使用只差一个糟糕的一天”。

segments.en: Pain is 6/10 after ketorolac and acetaminophen.
segments.zh: 使用酮咯酸和对乙酰氨基酚后疼痛为 6/10。

segments.en: HR and BP improved to HR 94 and BP 138/86.
segments.zh: HR 和 BP 改善至 HR 94、BP 138/86。

segments.en: He is tearful, fidgeting, and emotionally distressed.
segments.zh: 他流泪、坐立不安，并表现出情绪痛苦。

segments.en: He has not contacted Tanya or his sponsor.
segments.zh: 他尚未联系 Tanya 或赞助人。

segments.en: He says he does not want to “bother” his support people.
segments.zh: 他说不想“麻烦”支持他的人。

segments.en: He fears any fentanyl or opioid exposure will put him “right back where I started.”
segments.zh: 他担心任何芬太尼或阿片暴露都会让他“马上回到起点”。

segments.en: Urine drug screen is positive for prescribed buprenorphine and negative for illicit substances.
segments.zh: 尿药筛查为处方丁丙诺啡阳性，非法物质阴性。

byChoice.en: This passive, ambiguous statement requires exploration and documentation even after clarification.
byChoice.zh: 这类被动且含糊的表述即使随后被澄清，也需要进一步探询和记录。

byChoice.en: The denial of self-harm is reassuring, but by itself it is not the relapse-risk cue; it should not end the assessment.
byChoice.zh: 否认自伤令人放心，但其本身不是复发风险线索；评估不应因此结束。

byChoice.en: Catastrophic framing that he is one bad day from using points to overwhelmed coping and relapse risk.
byChoice.zh: 认为自己离再次使用只差一个糟糕的一天，提示应对能力被压垮和复发风险。

byChoice.en: Pain still needs treatment, but a 6/10 fracture pain score after partial relief does not by itself distinguish relapse risk.
byChoice.zh: 疼痛仍需处理，但止痛后骨折疼痛 6/10 本身不能区分复发风险。

byChoice.en: Improving HR and BP are expected with pain and anxiety relief and are not the primary psychosocial cues.
byChoice.zh: HR 和 BP 随疼痛和焦虑缓解而改善，属于预期变化，不是主要心理社会线索。

byChoice.en: Tearfulness, fidgeting, and distress beyond pain add weight to the psychosocial risk pattern.
byChoice.zh: 流泪、坐立不安以及超出单纯疼痛的痛苦，加重了心理社会风险模式。

byChoice.en: Not contacting recovery supports during an acute stressor is a relapse-warning behavior.
byChoice.zh: 在急性压力源下不联系恢复支持者，是复发警示行为。

byChoice.en: Calling support contact “bothering” others shows active distancing from the safety net.
byChoice.zh: 把联系支持者说成“麻烦别人”显示正在主动远离安全网。

byChoice.en: His opioid-exposure fear is protective but intense; it requires education and therapeutic support rather than dismissal.
byChoice.zh: 他对阿片暴露的担心具有保护性但很强烈，需要宣教和治疗性支持，而不是忽视。

byChoice.en: The UDS is reassuring and consistent with prescribed treatment; it does not require action as a relapse-risk cue.
byChoice.zh: 尿筛结果令人放心，符合处方治疗；它不是需要处理的复发风险线索。

correct.en: The significant cues are the ambiguous “easier if I did not have to deal with this” statement, catastrophic relapse framing, tearful emotional distress, avoidance of Tanya and the sponsor, framing support contact as “bothering” others, and fear that opioid exposure will trigger relapse. The denial of self-harm is important but does not erase the need to monitor; improved vital signs, moderate pain, and a negative illicit UDS are not the primary psychosocial cues.
correct.zh: 重要线索包括“如果不用面对这些会不会更容易”的含糊表述、灾难化的复发表述、流泪和情绪痛苦、回避 Tanya 和赞助人、把联系支持者说成“麻烦别人”，以及担心阿片暴露会诱发复发。否认自伤很重要，但不能取消继续监测的需要；生命体征改善、中等疼痛和非法物质尿筛阴性不是主要心理社会线索。

stem.en: Highlight the Stage 1 findings that are significant psychosocial relapse-risk cues requiring nursing attention.
stem.zh: 请标出阶段 1 中提示心理社会性复发风险、需要护士关注的重要线索。

testTakingStrategy.en: For cue recognition, separate expected physiologic responses from behavior changes that show loss of coping or loss of support.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 识别线索时，要区分预期的生理反应与显示应对能力或支持系统减弱的行为变化。

glossary.defZh: 停止或减少阿片后出现的一组体征和症状，如出汗、震颤、流涕、打哈欠、瞳孔散大和胃肠不适。
以获取药物为主要目的的行为；不能仅凭物质使用史或疼痛表达判断。
降低自伤或复发风险的因素，如支持关系、未来计划、求助意愿和治疗连接。

options.en: Primary cardiovascular instability from persistent hypertension and tachycardia
options.zh: 持续高血压和心动过速导致的主要心血管不稳定

options.en: Drug-seeking behavior because he is asking many questions about sedation
options.zh: 因反复询问镇静方案而属于觅药行为

options.en: Active opioid withdrawal requiring withdrawal-protocol medication
options.zh: 需要戒断方案药物处理的活动性阿片戒断

options.en: Acute suicidal crisis requiring involuntary safety hold based only on the first statement
options.zh: 仅凭最初表述即可判定需要非自愿安全留观的急性自杀危机

options.en: Acute relapse risk from converging pain, fear, shame, and self-isolation
options.zh: 疼痛、恐惧、羞耻和自我孤立共同导致的急性复发风险

byChoice.en: Withdrawal is unlikely because he lacks diaphoresis, tremor, piloerection, rhinorrhea, yawning, mydriasis, GI distress, and has buprenorphine exposure on UDS.
byChoice.zh: 戒断可能性低，因为他无出汗、震颤、鸡皮样皮肤、流涕、打哈欠、瞳孔散大、胃肠不适，且尿筛显示丁丙诺啡暴露。

byChoice.en: Correct. The cue pattern shows overwhelmed coping and disconnection from supports during a high-risk stressor.
byChoice.zh: 正确。线索模式显示在高风险压力源下应对能力被压垮，并与支持系统断开。

byChoice.en: His vital signs improved after analgesia and are consistent with pain and anxiety, not persistent cardiovascular instability.
byChoice.zh: 镇痛后生命体征改善，符合疼痛和焦虑，而非持续心血管不稳定。

byChoice.en: This reverses the meaning of his concern. He is trying to avoid opioid exposure, not requesting euphoric medication.
byChoice.zh: 这误解了他的担忧。他是在避免阿片暴露，而不是索要产生欣快的药物。

byChoice.en: His statement requires exploration and reassessment, but denial of intent/plan and preserved protective factors do not by themselves support an involuntary hold.
byChoice.zh: 他的表述需要探询和重新评估，但否认意图/计划且保护因素仍存在，本身不足以支持非自愿留观。

correct.en: The cluster best represents acute relapse risk: early recovery, prior relapse and overdose, acute fracture pain, fear of opioid exposure, emotional distress, and withdrawal from supports. There are no objective withdrawal signs; his anxiety is about avoiding opioids rather than obtaining them. He denied suicidal intent and plan, so the nurse monitors and reassesses rather than jumping to an involuntary hold.
correct.zh: 该线索组合最符合急性复发风险：早期恢复、既往复发和过量、急性骨折疼痛、害怕阿片暴露、情绪痛苦以及远离支持系统。没有客观戒断体征；他的焦虑是为了避免阿片，而不是索取阿片。他否认自杀意图和计划，因此护士应监测并重新评估，而不是直接做非自愿留观。

stem.en: The nurse analyzes the Stage 1 cue cluster. Which interpretation is most accurate?
stem.zh: 护士分析阶段 1 的线索组合。哪一种解释最准确？

testTakingStrategy.en: When several labels seem possible, match the label to objective findings and the patient’s behavior, not to stigma attached to the diagnosis.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 当多个标签看似可能时，应将标签与客观发现和患者行为匹配，而不是与诊断相关的污名匹配。

glossary.defZh: 保护患者健康信息，不在未经允许的情况下向他人透露。
患者与护士之间基于信任、尊重和共同目标的工作关系。
认为事情不会改善或努力没有意义的感受，是安全和复发风险评估的重要线索。

options.en: Call the MAT prescriber immediately because the buprenorphine plan has not been addressed.
options.zh: 立即联系 MAT 处方医生，因为丁丙诺啡方案尚未处理。

options.en: Focus on Marcus’s escalating hopelessness, emotional distress, and isolation using a therapeutic interaction and safety reassessment.
options.zh: 通过治疗性沟通和安全重新评估，优先处理 Marcus 日益加重的无望感、情绪痛苦和孤立。

options.en: Repeat the urine drug screen before speaking with Marcus to verify whether Tanya’s concern is true.
options.zh: 在与 Marcus 谈话前重复尿药筛查，以核实 Tanya 的担忧是否属实。

options.en: Complete medication discharge teaching first because pain control is the concrete discharge task.
options.zh: 先完成出院用药宣教，因为疼痛控制是具体的出院任务。

options.en: Answer Tanya’s hallway question directly because she is frightened and has overdose history context.
options.zh: 直接回答 Tanya 在走廊的问题，因为她害怕且了解过量史。

byChoice.en: Medication teaching is necessary, but it should not be prioritized over an actively worsening psychosocial safety concern.
byChoice.zh: 用药宣教必要，但不应优先于正在恶化的心理社会安全问题。

byChoice.en: Tanya’s fear is valid, but the nurse cannot confirm or deny Marcus’s substance-use status, UDS, or MAT plan without his permission.
byChoice.zh: Tanya 的恐惧是真实的，但未经 Marcus 许可，护士不能确认或否认其物质使用状态、尿筛或 MAT 方案。

byChoice.en: Repeating UDS does not address the immediate emotional deterioration and risks undermining trust.
byChoice.zh: 重复尿筛不能处理当前情绪恶化，而且可能破坏信任。

byChoice.en: Correct. His emotional trajectory and isolation are worsening and require immediate therapeutic engagement and safety reassessment.
byChoice.zh: 正确。他的情绪轨迹和孤立正在恶化，需要立即进行治疗性接触和安全重新评估。

byChoice.en: The MAT prescriber has already been contacted and the plan is documented, so this is not the immediate priority.
byChoice.zh: MAT 处方医生已联系且方案已记录，因此不是当前立即优先事项。

correct.en: Marcus has shifted from anxious but engaged to hopeless, ashamed, and isolated. That trajectory is the most immediate destabilizing concern because it can precede relapse or self-harm. Tanya’s fear should be validated without violating confidentiality, and she can be included in planning with Marcus’s consent. Medication teaching remains important, but teaching will be poorly retained if the patient is in emotional crisis. The MAT plan has already been clarified.
correct.zh: Marcus 已从焦虑但能参与，转变为无望、羞耻和孤立。这一变化轨迹是最需要立即处理的不稳定因素，因为它可能先于复发或自伤。应支持性地认可 Tanya 的恐惧，但不能违反保密；经 Marcus 同意后可让她参与计划。用药宣教仍重要，但患者处于情绪危机时很难吸收。MAT 方案已经澄清。

stem.en: At Stage 2, which concern should the nurse prioritize?
stem.zh: 在阶段 2，护士应优先处理哪一项问题？

testTakingStrategy.en: In psychosocial prioritization, look for the changing trajectory: worsening hopelessness and isolation outrank tasks that can wait.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 心理社会优先排序时，要看变化轨迹：加重的无望感和孤立高于可稍后完成的任务。

glossary.defZh: 把患者表达的情绪或含义用自己的话反馈给患者，以显示理解。
用空泛积极话语安慰患者，却未处理其真实担忧。
评估自伤/自杀意念、计划、意图、保护因素和可用支持的过程。

options.en: Offer concrete help contacting his sponsor or another recovery support before discharge.
options.zh: 在出院前提供具体帮助，让他联系赞助人或其他恢复支持者。

options.en: Tell Marcus that Tanya reported the 2 AM car incident so he understands why she is worried.
options.zh: 告诉 Marcus，Tanya 报告了凌晨 2 点车内事件，让他理解她为什么担心。

options.en: Ask Marcus for permission to include Tanya in safety planning while keeping private information confidential.
options.zh: 请求 Marcus 允许 Tanya 参与安全计划，同时保护隐私信息。

options.en: Explore “what’s the point” and reassess for suicidal thoughts if his response suggests passive ideation.
options.zh: 探询“有什么意义”的含义；若回答提示被动意念，则重新评估自杀想法。

options.en: Use reassurance such as, “You’re doing great; just stay positive and don’t think about using.”
options.zh: 使用安慰性话语，如：“你做得很好；保持积极，不要想着使用。”

options.en: Reflect the feeling without judgment: “It sounds like you feel hurt and exhausted by being distrusted.”
options.zh: 不带评判地反映感受：“听起来你因为被不信任而感到受伤和疲惫。”

byChoice.en: Correct. Consent-based inclusion of Tanya protects privacy while using an available support.
byChoice.zh: 正确。基于同意让 Tanya 参与，既保护隐私又利用可用支持。

byChoice.en: False reassurance and “just stay positive” minimize the patient’s distress and may shut down disclosure.
byChoice.zh: 虚假安慰和“保持积极”会淡化患者痛苦，并可能终止进一步倾诉。

byChoice.en: Correct. Exploring the phrase deepens the conversation and functions as a safety screen when indicated.
byChoice.zh: 正确。探询该表述既能深化对话，也能在需要时起到安全筛查作用。

byChoice.en: This weaponizes Tanya’s private concern and confirms Marcus’s fear that others are talking behind his back.
byChoice.zh: 这会把 Tanya 的私下担忧变成伤害工具，并证实 Marcus 担心别人背后议论他。

byChoice.en: Correct. Reflection shows the nurse hears the feeling without arguing or judging.
byChoice.zh: 正确。反映情绪显示护士听见了他的感受，而不是争辩或评判。

byChoice.en: Correct. Concrete help lowers the barrier to reconnecting with recovery supports.
byChoice.zh: 正确。具体帮助能降低重新连接恢复支持的门槛。

correct.en: Therapeutic communication should validate the feeling without endorsing the distortion that recovery is pointless. The nurse should explore the phrase “what’s the point,” reassess safety if passive ideation is suggested, offer concrete support-contact help, and include Tanya only with Marcus’s consent. Disclosing Tanya’s hallway comments or using platitudes would worsen shame and damage trust.
correct.zh: 治疗性沟通应肯定情绪，但不强化“恢复没有意义”的认知扭曲。护士应探询“有什么意义”这句话，若提示被动意念则重新评估安全，提供联系支持者的具体帮助，并仅在 Marcus 同意时让 Tanya 参与。透露 Tanya 在走廊的谈话或使用空泛安慰会加重羞耻并破坏信任。

stem.en: Which nursing responses are appropriate for Marcus’s Stage 2 statement, “What’s the point of staying clean if everyone still treats you like a junkie?” Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 对于 Marcus 在阶段 2 说“如果所有人还把我当瘾君子，看我保持干净有什么意义？”，哪些护理回应是恰当的？选择所有适用项。

testTakingStrategy.en: Choose responses that invite more disclosure and protect trust; avoid responses that argue, reassure superficially, or disclose another person’s private statements.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 选择能促进进一步表达并保护信任的回应；避免争辩、表面安慰或透露他人私下说法。

glossary.defZh: 降低伤害和死亡风险的实际策略，如纳洛酮准备和过量识别。
结合不同机制的药物和非药物措施控制疼痛。
可逆转阿片过量导致呼吸抑制的阿片受体拮抗剂。
对使用物质的强烈冲动，可出现于恢复过程中并需安全应对。

options.en: Teach scheduled acetaminophen and ibuprofen use, acetaminophen daily limit/duplicate-product safety, and avoiding NSAID overlap after ketorolac.
options.zh: 宣教定时使用对乙酰氨基酚和布洛芬、对乙酰氨基酚每日上限/避免重复含药产品，以及酮咯酸后避免 NSAID 重叠。

options.en: Reinforce the ordered buprenorphine/naloxone plan and explain that it supports OUD treatment and contributes to analgesia.
options.zh: 强化已开具的丁丙诺啡/纳洛酮方案，并说明其支持 OUD 治疗且有助于镇痛。

options.en: Thank him for disclosing craving and reinforce that cravings can occur without meaning relapse is inevitable.
options.zh: 感谢他坦诚说出渴求，并强调出现渴求并不代表复发不可避免。

options.en: Tell him to avoid returning to the ED for uncontrolled pain because any opioid discussion could threaten recovery.
options.zh: 告诉他若疼痛无法控制也应避免回急诊，因为任何阿片讨论都可能威胁恢复。

options.en: Help him call his sponsor, confirm the MAT follow-up, and problem-solve transportation or remote attendance for the NA meeting before discharge.
options.zh: 出院前帮助他致电赞助人、确认 MAT 随访，并解决 NA 会议交通或远程参加问题。

options.en: Review naloxone with Marcus and Tanya: check the printed expiration date, replace expired kits, call 911, administer available naloxone in an overdose emergency, and review overdose signs.
options.zh: 与 Marcus 和 Tanya 复习纳洛酮：查看包装印刷有效期、替换过期套装、拨打 911、过量紧急情况下使用可用纳洛酮，并复习过量征象。

byChoice.en: Correct. Naloxone teaching is harm reduction and should include expiration checking, replacement, overdose recognition, emergency activation, and administration.
byChoice.zh: 正确。纳洛酮宣教属于减害，应包括查有效期、替换、识别过量、启动急救和给药。

byChoice.en: Correct. Scheduled nonopioid analgesia, acetaminophen safety, and NSAID spacing reduce pain and medication harm.
byChoice.zh: 正确。定时非阿片镇痛、对乙酰氨基酚安全和 NSAID 间隔可减轻疼痛并减少用药伤害。

byChoice.en: Correct. Shame-free response encourages future disclosure and frames craving as manageable.
byChoice.zh: 正确。无羞辱回应鼓励未来继续坦诚，并把渴求视为可管理。

byChoice.en: Correct. Continuing the ordered MAT plan supports anti-craving treatment and can contribute to pain control.
byChoice.zh: 正确。继续已开具的 MAT 方案可支持抗渴求治疗，并有助于疼痛控制。

byChoice.en: Correct. Concrete logistics turn abstract advice into an activated support plan before he leaves.
byChoice.zh: 正确。具体后勤安排把抽象建议转化为离院前已启动的支持计划。

byChoice.en: This is unsafe. Uncontrolled pain is a relapse driver; he should seek supervised reassessment rather than self-medicating or avoiding care.
byChoice.zh: 这不安全。无法控制的疼痛会推动复发；他应寻求受监督的重新评估，而不是自行用药或回避照护。

correct.en: The discharge plan must integrate relapse prevention, pain control, harm reduction, and concrete logistics. Marcus needs validation for honest craving disclosure, a clear scheduled multimodal pain plan, continuation of ordered buprenorphine/naloxone, activated recovery supports, confirmed follow-up, transportation planning, and naloxone/overdose teaching with Tanya. He should have a supervised escalation pathway if pain becomes uncontrolled; avoiding care would increase suffering and relapse risk.
correct.zh: 出院计划必须整合复发预防、疼痛控制、减害和具体后勤安排。Marcus 需要因坦诚报告渴求而得到肯定，需要明确的定时多模式镇痛方案、继续按医嘱使用丁丙诺啡/纳洛酮、启动恢复支持、确认随访、安排交通，并与 Tanya 复习纳洛酮/过量宣教。若疼痛无法控制，应有受监督的升级就医路径；回避照护会增加痛苦和复发风险。

stem.en: At Stage 3, which actions should the nurse include in discharge teaching and safety planning? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 在阶段 3，护士应将哪些措施纳入出院宣教和安全计划？选择所有适用项。

testTakingStrategy.en: For discharge in OUD recovery, choose plans that solve the patient’s stated barriers and create an escalation path; do not give “avoid care” instructions.
testTakingStrategy.zh: OUD 恢复期出院题应选择能解决患者已说出障碍并建立升级路径的计划；不要选择“避免就医”的指示。

glossary.defZh: 让患者愿意保持安全和继续治疗的个人理由或关系。
将风险告知医生、社工、行为健康团队或启动更高层级安全措施。
患者能够谈论并参与未来数小时至数天的安全、随访和支持计划。

rows.en: Marcus contacted his sponsor before leaving and has a confirmed MAT appointment within 48 hours.
rows.zh: Marcus 离院前已联系赞助人，并确认 48 小时内 MAT 预约。

rows.en: He verbalizes the scheduled pain plan and knows whom to call or where to return if pain is uncontrolled.
rows.zh: 他能说出定时疼痛方案，并知道疼痛无法控制时该联系谁或去哪里。

rows.en: Marcus and Tanya can describe opioid overdose signs and naloxone administration steps.
rows.zh: Marcus 和 Tanya 能描述阿片过量征象及纳洛酮给药步骤。

rows.en: He denies suicidal ideation on reassessment and is engaged in planning for tonight and tomorrow.
rows.zh: 重新评估时他否认自杀意念，并参与今晚和明天的计划。

rows.en: Marcus says he intends to use heroin tonight if the pain becomes severe.
rows.zh: Marcus 说如果今晚疼痛严重，他打算使用海洛因。

rows.en: He refuses to contact any support, refuses follow-up, and says there is no reason to stay in recovery.
rows.zh: 他拒绝联系任何支持者、拒绝随访，并说没有理由继续保持恢复。

rows.en: Tanya reports recent self-harm statements and access to a firearm at home.
rows.zh: Tanya 报告他近期有自伤言论，且家中可接触枪支。

rows.en: On reassessment, he says, “I might be better off not waking up,” and cannot identify protective reasons to stay safe.
rows.zh: 重新评估时他说：“也许不醒来会更好”，且无法说出保持安全的保护性理由。

byChoice.en: Active contact with recovery support and confirmed MAT follow-up are objective markers of a working safety plan.
byChoice.zh: 主动联系恢复支持并确认 MAT 随访，是安全计划有效运行的客观标志。

byChoice.en: Understanding the pain plan and escalation pathway reduces the risk of self-medicating when pain worsens.
byChoice.zh: 理解疼痛方案和升级路径，可降低疼痛加重时自行用药的风险。

byChoice.en: Naloxone readiness with Tanya supports harm reduction if an overdose emergency occurs.
byChoice.zh: Tanya 掌握纳洛酮准备，能在过量紧急情况下支持减害。

byChoice.en: Denial of SI plus engaged, near-term planning suggests he is not leaving in acute crisis.
byChoice.zh: 否认自杀意念且参与近期计划，提示他并非处于急性危机中离院。

byChoice.en: A stated intent to use opioids after discharge is an immediate relapse-safety concern and requires provider/team escalation.
byChoice.zh: 明确表示出院后打算使用阿片是即时复发安全问题，需要通知医生/团队升级处理。

byChoice.en: Refusal of all supports and inability to name a recovery reason show the safety net is not in place.
byChoice.zh: 拒绝所有支持且无法说出恢复理由，说明安全网尚未建立。

byChoice.en: Self-harm statements plus firearm access materially changes the safety risk and requires escalation.
byChoice.zh: 自伤言论加枪支可及会实质改变安全风险，需要升级处理。

byChoice.en: New passive suicidal ideation without protective reasons requires further safety evaluation before discharge.
byChoice.zh: 新发被动自杀意念且缺乏保护性理由，需要出院前进一步安全评估。

correct.en: Safe discharge is supported when the safety net is active: recovery support contacted, MAT follow-up confirmed, pain and naloxone plans understood, suicidal ideation denied, and the patient is engaged and future-oriented. Escalation is required for intent to use, refusal of all supports/follow-up, loss of protective factors, new suicidal ideation, or collateral information suggesting self-harm risk or weapon access.
correct.zh: 当安全网已启动时支持安全出院：已联系恢复支持者、确认 MAT 随访、理解疼痛和纳洛酮方案、否认自杀意念，并能参与计划、面向未来。若出现使用意图、拒绝所有支持/随访、保护因素丧失、新发自杀意念，或旁系信息提示自伤风险/武器可及，则需升级处理。

stem.en: Classify each Stage 3 finding as supporting safe discharge with the current plan or requiring escalation before discharge.
stem.zh: 将每个阶段 3 发现分类为支持按当前计划安全出院，或出院前需要升级处理。

testTakingStrategy.en: Evaluate outcomes by looking for both objective safety-net markers and qualitative change in engagement, future orientation, and protective factors.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 评估结果时，同时寻找客观安全网标志，以及参与度、未来导向和保护因素的质性变化。

content.en: Marcus receives ketorolac 15 mg IV and acetaminophen 1,000 mg PO. After 45 minutes, pain decreases from 8/10 to 6/10; HR 94, BP 138/86, RR 16, SpO2 99%. He remains anxious and asks whether fentanyl will be used for sedation, saying, “I can’t have fentanyl. I’ll be right back where I started.” He then says quietly, “Sometimes I think it would be easier if I just didn’t have to deal with any of this anymore.” When asked to clarify, he says, “I don’t mean like that. I’m not going to hurt myself. I just mean recovery is exhausting. Every time something goes wrong I feel like I’m one bad day away from using again.” He has not contacted Tanya or his sponsor because he does not want to “bother” them. Regional anesthesia discusses an ultrasound-guided brachial plexus nerve block to avoid systemic opioid use; Marcus agrees but remains tense. The provider confirms nerve block for analgesia, propofol for brief procedural sedation, and continued multimodal non-opioid pain management. The buprenorphine/naloxone hold still needs clarification before a dose is missed.
content.zh: Marcus 接受酮咯酸 15 mg IV 和对乙酰氨基酚 1,000 mg PO。45 分钟后，疼痛从 8/10 降至 6/10；HR 94，BP 138/86，RR 16，SpO2 99%。他仍焦虑，询问镇静是否会使用芬太尼，并说：“我不能用芬太尼。我会马上回到起点。”随后他低声说：“有时候我觉得如果不用再面对这些，会不会更容易。”护士请他说明时，他说：“我不是那个意思。我不会伤害自己。我只是觉得恢复太累了。每次出问题，我都觉得自己离再次使用只差一个糟糕的一天。”他还没有联系 Tanya 或赞助人，因为不想“麻烦”他们。区域麻醉团队讨论超声引导臂丛神经阻滞，以避免全身性阿片使用；Marcus 同意但仍紧张。医生确认使用神经阻滞镇痛、丙泊酚短暂程序镇静，并继续多模式非阿片镇痛。丁丙诺啡/纳洛酮暂缓医嘱仍需在漏服前澄清。

title.en: Stage 1 — ED arrival through pre-procedure preparation (0–2 hours)
title.zh: 阶段 1——急诊到达至术前准备（0–2 小时）

content.en: Closed reduction is successful under propofol sedation with the nerve block in place. Marcus wakes oriented and without nausea. Post-procedure vitals: HR 82, BP 126/78, RR 14, SpO2 99%. Pain is 2/10 while the nerve block is active. The ED provider has spoken with the MAT prescriber. Orders now state: resume buprenorphine/naloxone 16 mg/4 mg sublingual daily tonight; acetaminophen 1,000 mg PO every 6 hours; ibuprofen 400 mg PO every 6 hours with food, beginning at the next scheduled NSAID interval to avoid overlap with ketorolac; ice and elevation; orthopedic follow-up in 5 days; MAT follow-up within 48 hours; return precautions for cast complications. Tanya arrives upset and asks the nurse in the hallway, outside Marcus’s hearing, “Is he using again? Please just tell me the truth.” She reports recent insomnia, moodiness, and finding him sitting alone in the car at 2 AM. Marcus later says, “She doesn’t trust me. Nobody does. What’s the point of staying clean if everyone still treats you like a junkie?” His eyes are red, he picks at the cast edge, denies suicidal ideation when asked directly, and says, “I just feel really alone right now.”
content.zh: 在神经阻滞起效的情况下，Marcus 在丙泊酚镇静下成功闭合复位。他醒来后定向力正常，无恶心。术后生命体征：HR 82，BP 126/78，RR 14，SpO2 99%。神经阻滞仍有效时疼痛 2/10。急诊医生已与 MAT 处方医生沟通。现医嘱为：今晚恢复丁丙诺啡/纳洛酮 16 mg/4 mg 舌下每日一次；对乙酰氨基酚 1,000 mg PO 每 6 小时；布洛芬 400 mg PO 每 6 小时随食物服用，从下一个预定 NSAID 间隔开始，以避免与酮咯酸重叠；冰敷和抬高；5 天后骨科随访；48 小时内 MAT 随访；告知石膏并发症返回就诊警示。Tanya 到达时情绪激动，在 Marcus 听不到的走廊问护士：“他是不是又用了？请直接告诉我真相。”她报告他近期失眠、情绪不稳，并曾在凌晨 2 点发现他独自坐在车里。Marcus 后来说：“她不信任我。没人信任我。如果所有人还把我当瘾君子，看我保持干净有什么意义？”他的眼睛发红，抠石膏边缘，直接询问时否认自杀意念，并说：“我现在真的觉得很孤单。”

title.en: Stage 2 — Post-procedure through ED observation (2–6 hours)
title.zh: 阶段 2——术后至急诊观察（2–6 小时）

content.en: The nerve block is beginning to wear off. Marcus reports left wrist pain increasing to 5/10. Vitals: HR 88, BP 132/82, RR 16, SpO2 99%. He took the evening buprenorphine/naloxone dose 30 minutes ago and has taken acetaminophen and ibuprofen as scheduled. He is restless and says, “This is exactly the kind of thing that made me use before — being in pain, feeling like crap, not being able to work. I know what would make this pain go away in five minutes.” He pauses and adds, “I’m not going to do it. But I’d be lying if I said I wasn’t thinking about it.” Tanya is present and alarmed. Marcus has not called his sponsor, is unsure he will attend tomorrow’s NA meeting because he cannot drive with the cast, and has not confirmed his MAT follow-up appointment. He asks whether ibuprofen will be enough, what to do if pain becomes severe overnight, and whether Tanya’s approximately 1-year-old naloxone kit still works.
content.zh: 神经阻滞开始减退。Marcus 报告左腕疼痛升至 5/10。生命体征：HR 88，BP 132/82，RR 16，SpO2 99%。他 30 分钟前服用了晚间丁丙诺啡/纳洛酮，并按时服用了对乙酰氨基酚和布洛芬。他坐立不安，说：“这种情况正是以前让我再次使用的原因——疼痛、感觉很糟、不能工作。我知道有一种东西五分钟内就能让疼痛消失。”他停顿后说：“我不会那么做。但如果说我没想到它，那就是撒谎。”Tanya 在场并显得惊慌。Marcus 尚未致电赞助人，因为戴石膏不能开车而不确定是否参加明晚的 NA 会议，也尚未确认 MAT 随访。他询问布洛芬是否足够、如果夜里疼痛严重该怎么办，以及 Tanya 大约一年前的纳洛酮套装是否仍有效。

title.en: Stage 3 — Discharge preparation and teaching (6–8 hours)
title.zh: 阶段 3——出院准备和宣教（6–8 小时）

summary.en: A client with OUD in early recovery presents with an acute fracture, severe pain, anxiety about opioid exposure, and progressive emotional isolation during discharge planning.
summary.zh: 一名处于早期恢复期的 OUD 患者因急性骨折就诊，存在重度疼痛、对阿片暴露的焦虑，并在出院计划过程中逐渐出现情绪孤立。

title.en: Opioid use disorder in early recovery: relapse risk, pain management, and safety planning after orthopedic injury
title.zh: 早期恢复期阿片类物质使用障碍：骨科损伤后的复发风险、疼痛管理与安全计划

glossary.defZh: 以失控使用、渴求、功能受损和持续风险为特征的物质使用障碍。
用于 OUD 治疗的组合药物，丁丙诺啡为部分阿片受体激动剂，纳洛酮用于降低误用风险。
将获批药物与咨询和行为支持结合，用于治疗物质使用障碍的模式。
为短暂疼痛性操作提供镇静和舒适的受监督药物过程。
识别阿片过量、拨打急救电话、给予纳洛酮并持续观察/支持呼吸的步骤。

correct.en: Across the case, the nurse must recognize that Marcus’s strongest risk is not withdrawal, drug seeking, or a single vital-sign abnormality, but acute relapse risk caused by converging physical pain, fear, shame, and self-isolation. Safe care preserves OUD treatment, treats pain with a supervised multimodal plan, protects confidentiality, uses nonjudgmental therapeutic communication, activates recovery supports before discharge, teaches naloxone and overdose response with Tanya when Marcus consents, and evaluates readiness by whether supports and follow-up are actually in place.
correct.zh: 整个病例中，护士必须识别 Marcus 最大的风险不是戒断、觅药或单一生命体征异常，而是由身体疼痛、恐惧、羞耻和自我孤立共同导致的急性复发风险。安全护理应维持 OUD 治疗，在监督下使用多模式疼痛方案，保护保密性，采用非评判性治疗沟通，在出院前启动恢复支持，并在 Marcus 同意时与 Tanya 进行纳洛酮和过量应对宣教，同时通过支持和随访是否真正落实来评估出院准备。

stem.en: Review the client record and answer the case-study items.
stem.zh: 请查看患者病历，并回答本病例题组。

testTakingStrategy.en: For unfolding OUD cases, avoid stigmatizing shortcuts. Follow the changing cue pattern: pain control, support connection, safety reassessment, confidentiality, and harm-reduction readiness.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 处理 OUD 展开病例时，避免污名化捷径。跟随线索变化：疼痛控制、支持连接、安全重新评估、保密性和减害准备。

tokens.en: Activate the recovery-support plan before discharge: sponsor/NA logistics/MAT follow-up
tokens.zh: 出院前启动恢复支持计划：赞助人、NA 后勤和 MAT 随访

tokens.en: Complete paperwork and written instructions without addressing barriers
tokens.zh: 只完成文书和书面说明，不处理障碍

tokens.en: Teach the supervised pain plan and naloxone/overdose response with Marcus and Tanya
tokens.zh: 与 Marcus 和 Tanya 宣教受监督疼痛方案及纳洛酮/过量应对

tokens.en: Request a psychiatric hold solely because he disclosed craving
tokens.zh: 仅因他透露渴求而申请精神科留观

tokens.en: Acute relapse risk from converging physical and psychosocial stressors
tokens.zh: 身体和心理社会压力共同导致的急性复发风险

tokens.en: Acute suicidal crisis requiring involuntary psychiatric hold
tokens.zh: 需要非自愿精神科留观的急性自杀危机

tokens.en: Repeat urine drug screen at MAT follow-up as the primary ED safety marker
tokens.zh: 以 MAT 随访时重复尿筛作为主要急诊安全指标

tokens.en: Engagement with recovery supports and confirmed follow-up
tokens.zh: 恢复支持参与情况及确认的随访

tokens.en: Pain trajectory over the next 24–48 hours
tokens.zh: 未来 24–48 小时的疼痛变化

tokens.en: Serial HR and BP monitoring as the primary discharge outcome
tokens.zh: 以连续 HR 和 BP 监测作为主要出院结果

glossary.defZh: 要求连接最可能状况、优先措施和监测参数的 NGN 题型。
通过支持、治疗连接、应对计划和风险降低措施减少再次使用的策略。
疼痛在一段时间内的变化方向和控制情况。

byChoice.en: Correct. He has pain, functional stress, shame, isolation, and craving with insight, making relapse prevention the central risk.
byChoice.zh: 正确。他有疼痛、功能压力、羞耻、孤立和有自知力的渴求，因此复发预防是核心风险。

byChoice.en: Incorrect. He took buprenorphine/naloxone, has no objective withdrawal signs, and his distress is pain- and psychosocially driven.
byChoice.zh: 不正确。他已服用丁丙诺啡/纳洛酮，无客观戒断体征，其痛苦主要由疼痛和心理社会因素驱动。

byChoice.en: Incorrect. He requires reassessment and planning, but repeated denial of suicidal intent and preserved engagement do not by themselves justify an involuntary psychiatric hold.
byChoice.zh: 不正确。他需要重新评估和计划，但反复否认自杀意图且仍能参与，本身不足以支持非自愿精神科留观。

byChoice.en: Correct. He is leaving a high-risk transition and has not yet activated sponsor, NA, or MAT follow-up supports.
byChoice.zh: 正确。他正处于高风险过渡期，尚未启动赞助人、NA 或 MAT 随访支持。

byChoice.en: Correct. Uncontrolled pain can drive relapse, and naloxone readiness lowers overdose mortality risk if relapse occurs.
byChoice.zh: 正确。无法控制的疼痛可推动复发；若发生复发，纳洛酮准备可降低过量死亡风险。

byChoice.en: Incorrect. Craving with insight and stated intent not to use should be met with planning and support, not automatic loss of autonomy.
byChoice.zh: 不正确。伴有自知力且表明不打算使用的渴求，应通过计划和支持处理，而不是自动剥夺自主权。

byChoice.en: Incorrect. Written instructions without solving transport, follow-up, pain escalation, and support contact barriers leave the safety plan inactive.
byChoice.zh: 不正确。若不解决交通、随访、疼痛升级和联系支持者的障碍，只有书面说明会让安全计划无法启动。

byChoice.en: Correct. Support engagement is a modifiable marker of whether the relapse-prevention plan is active.
byChoice.zh: 正确。支持参与情况是复发预防计划是否启动的可改变指标。

byChoice.en: Correct. Pain control over the next 24–48 hours directly affects suffering and relapse risk.
byChoice.zh: 正确。未来 24–48 小时的疼痛控制直接影响痛苦和复发风险。

byChoice.en: Incorrect. UDS can be part of MAT care, but it detects relapse after the fact and does not measure whether the ED safety plan is active.
byChoice.zh: 不正确。尿筛可作为 MAT 照护的一部分，但它是在事后发现复发，不能衡量急诊安全计划是否启动。

byChoice.en: Incorrect. His vital signs normalized with pain control; serial HR/BP does not evaluate the psychosocial discharge safety plan.
byChoice.zh: 不正确。他的生命体征随疼痛控制而正常化；连续 HR/BP 不能评估心理社会出院安全计划。

correct.en: The bow-tie centers on acute relapse risk, not current withdrawal or an involuntary-hold-level suicidal crisis. The nurse’s two priority actions are to activate the recovery support network and provide integrated pain-management and naloxone teaching. The most useful parameters are whether support/follow-up are actually engaged and whether pain remains controlled over the next 24–48 hours.
correct.zh: 蝴蝶结题聚焦急性复发风险，而不是当前戒断或达到非自愿留观级别的自杀危机。护士的两个优先措施是启动恢复支持网络，并提供整合的疼痛管理和纳洛酮宣教。最有用的监测参数是支持/随访是否真正启动，以及未来 24–48 小时疼痛是否得到控制。

stem.en: At discharge, Marcus’s nerve block is wearing off, pain is rising to 5/10, he has resumed buprenorphine/naloxone, and he openly acknowledges craving while stating he does not intend to use. He has not contacted his sponsor, has not confirmed MAT follow-up, is unsure how he will attend NA, and asks about pain escalation and Tanya’s naloxone kit. Complete the bow-tie by selecting the most likely condition, two priority actions, and two parameters to monitor.
stem.zh: 出院时，Marcus 的神经阻滞正在减退，疼痛升至 5/10，他已恢复丁丙诺啡/纳洛酮，并坦诚承认有渴求但表示不打算使用。他尚未联系赞助人、尚未确认 MAT 随访、不确定如何参加 NA，并询问疼痛加重和 Tanya 的纳洛酮套装。请完成蝴蝶结题：选择最可能的状况、两个优先措施和两个需要监测的参数。

testTakingStrategy.en: For bow-tie questions, anchor the condition first, then choose actions and monitoring parameters that directly test whether that condition is improving.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 做蝴蝶结题时，先锚定状况，再选择能直接检验该状况是否改善的措施和监测参数。
